evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct search method (fingerprinting) not substantially contained in other search/recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based search is different from fingerprinting, similar-users search, and recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similar-users-based search is distinct from profile-based search and from recommendation stories (receive recommendations vs search).

evaluations.evidence: music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Content-similarity search seeded by a music video is not duplicated elsewhere (others are general music search or video similarity info).

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/image-tag-driven discovery is distinct from fingerprinting, profile, similar-users, and ASR search.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Tag-preserving upload requirement is not expressed by any other story.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: UI requirement to view thumbnail sequences is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially overlaps with ZO-009, which also requests info about similar video items/segments; 'perceptually' does not create a meaningful separate requirement here.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates ZO-008's requirement to get info about similar video items/segments; difference is not clearly a distinct goal/context.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation from similar profiles is distinct from profile-based search (ZO-002) and similar-users search (ZO-003).

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Location/news-event-based recommendation is not duplicated by other recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is a distinct entity type compared to products/logos/brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is distinct from persons/logos/brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is distinct from persons/products/brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is distinct from products and broadcaster logos as separate target entities.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-seeded video recommendation is not duplicated by other recommendation/search stories.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Map-based exploration/notification is distinct from other recommendation/search mechanisms.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a distinct search modality not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation validation/editing is not duplicated by other admin stories (annotation, filtering, nudity, etc.).

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Topic extraction/annotation differs from segmentation editing (ZO-019) and other filtering/prefiltering tasks.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: A/V quality ranking is distinct from nudity/copyright/asset-info prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Audio-edit detection is distinct from other filtering/prefiltering requirements.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is distinct from copyright and asset-information prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset-info prefiltering is distinct from high-level metadata/tag prefiltering (ZO-026).

evaluations.evidence: validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is distinct from other prefiltering criteria (nudity, asset info, quality).

evaluations.evidence: prefilter ... using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag prefiltering is distinct from low-level asset-info prefiltering (ZO-024).

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Image interestingness/appeal assessment is not duplicated by other Zooniverse-admin automation stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Scientist-prompt detection is distinct from interestingness scoring (ZO-027) and volunteer interruption/education triggers (ZO-049/ZO-051).

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-type identification is distinct from weighting volunteer classifications (ZO-043) and interruption/education decisions.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo-specific preclassification is distinct from other project-specific preclassification/detection stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Empty/none-classifiable animal detection is distinct from species/attribute/number preclassification in the same project.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection ... timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Series detection for timestamp malfunction is distinct from other Snapshot Serengeti classification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification differs from attribute preclassification (ZO-034) and number detection (ZO-035).

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification is distinct from species preclassification and number detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Number detection is distinct from species/attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization differs from plankton presence detection, size/orientation detection, and species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: No-classifiable-plankton detection is distinct from segmentation, size/orientation, and species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is distinct from segmentation/localization and species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is distinct from size/orientation detection and segmentation/localization.

evaluations.evidence: automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis for duration reduction is distinct from detecting egg-laying time (ZO-041).

evaluations.evidence: detect the time ... where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying event detection is distinct from general motion analysis for shortening videos (ZO-040).

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads
evaluations.rationale: Disaster-feature detection in satellite images is not duplicated by other image-processing stories.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer classification weighting is distinct from identifying volunteer types (ZO-029) and interruption/education triggers.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal prefiltering is distinct from moving/transient object detection (ZO-045).

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is distinct from artefact removal (ZO-044).

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is distinct from whale-call grouping and whale counting.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping similar whale calls is distinct from counting whales in an audio file (ZO-048).

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Whale counting is distinct from grouping calls (ZO-047) and audio denoising (ZO-046).

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Interruption timing is distinct from choosing interruption modality (ZO-050) and from education timing (ZO-051).

evaluations.evidence: interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Selecting interruption modality is distinct from deciding whether/when to interrupt (ZO-049).

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education timing is distinct from interruption timing (ZO-049) and from choosing education modality/content (ZO-052/ZO-053).

evaluations.evidence: educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Selecting education modality is distinct from deciding when to educate (ZO-051).

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting specific educational content is distinct from education timing (ZO-051) and modality (ZO-052).

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting volunteer comments is distinct from deciding when Zoonibot should comment/explain (ZO-055/ZO-056).

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Bot-comment timing is distinct from bot-explanation timing (ZO-056) and from bot message content (ZO-057).

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Bot-explanation timing is distinct from bot-comment timing (ZO-055) and from deciding what to say (ZO-057).

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Bot message content selection is distinct from triggers/timing for commenting/explaining (ZO-055/ZO-056).

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Grouping subjects by similarity is not duplicated by other stories (recommendations are different goals).

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation to volunteers is distinct from other recommendation stories (which target content items/videos/music).

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is not expressed elsewhere in the backlog.
